svg.title: inkling-cmp-engine Architecture
svg.desc:
inkling-cmp-engine Architecture Pure-Rust + CUDA sm_80 single-model serving stack for 1-8x NVIDIA CMP 170HX (64 GB, 140 W cap) States shown: Live. Solid lines: data flows today.
Blocks, left to right: - OpenAI Clients (Loopback HTTP / load balancer): /v1/chat/completions; /v1/completions; Streaming SSE; Tool calls & thinking - Pure-Rust Front End (Zero Python, Tokio async): ink-server + ink-api; ink-text renderer; ink-parse tools/think; Prometheus /metrics - Prefix Scheduler (ink-sched (up to 8 slots)): Paged KV pool; Prefix checkpoints; 150 ms steal grace; Chunked prefill/decode - Target Looped MoE (kpack (367 kernels, 0 spills)): 18.98 GB NVFP4_N1S1; 40 SWA + 8 global; 16-row decode attn; TC prefill rel-bias - Exact Speculative Path (Ptok3 gated verify (1..16 rows)): DSpark Markov (default); Verbatim lookup (8); DFlash2 (opt-in); 128-bit Leviathan Groups: - CUDA sm_80 Runtime (ink-runtime, 140 W) (Embedded byte-reproducible cubins): Target Looped MoE, Exact Speculative Path Lines: - OpenAI Clients -> Pure-Rust Front End, labeled "HTTP / SSE" - Pure-Rust Front End -> Prefix Scheduler, labeled "token IDs" - Prefix Scheduler -> Target Looped MoE, labeled "prefill / verify" - Prefix Scheduler -> Exact Speculative Path, labeled "draft round" - Exact Speculative Path -> Target Looped MoE, labeled "<= 15 drafts" Note: Scaling. One card per replica (127.0.0.1:8400..8407); 4.13M BF16 or 8.26M+ FP8 KV tokens across 8 cards.
